## findings (frozen, pre-reveal)
1. T0-TERM — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (+ SOURCE-TASK). Symptom: term_years_ren tests nothing. Root cause: (a) SHAPE (cite _difficulty.md); (b) persona "If the agent asks how long to renew it for, you say to keep it on the same kind of term it has now" hands the agent the factor's tier; (c) stamp subscription_years=2 equals the tier. Consequence: an agent that never reads the term factor and asks the customer, or reads the stamp, books 2 years and 1788.37 — the factor bears no weight against the persona/stamp; an agent that does neither books 1 year 938.88 and the co-termed charge becomes 834.11. Also: base ssl_renewal lets the customer choose 1–3 years; a rule fixing the term by the last term line is not a treatment a reseller gives (UNREAL member). Artifacts: support_renewal factor term_years_ren; persona; seed holding.
2. T0-OWN — SOURCE-CHAIN RED: cite _difficulty.md OWN; here the only user write is the co-termed order.
3. T0-EVT — SOURCE-POLICY RED: EVT-a, consequence above.
4. T0-UNREAL — SOURCE-FACTOR RED: U1 members dom_bundle_ren and dom_bundle_co fire on the domain's auto_renew=true (credits 10.00 / 8.00 instead of 5.00 / 4.00).
5. T0-SEED — SOURCE-FACTOR RED: seeded added-names line d812482f… (2026-04-20) adds 2 names in one order at 79.55 = base proration 59.99·2·242/365; the in-force rule says "Names are added one name to an order" and, on this world, prices each name 59.99·242/365 = 39.77 less the 1.50 name domain credit (domain active, auto) → two lines of 38.27; the seeded ledger is not one the charter produces.
Observations: O5 (proration reading 1802.30); persona line "because you were going to renew it anyway" is a mild nudge but conditional on the agent's explanation.
